title: Ultra Jerai Geopark Trail Brings Economic Benefits To Local Communities
summary: YAN, Nov 24 (Bernama) -- The international-standard extreme sports event, Ultra Jerai Geopark Trail (UJGT) 2026, held here, not only tested participants’ physical endurance but also generated economic benefits for local communities through increased tourism activities and business opportunities.

title: Tiong: No Additional Conditions In PSB-PDP Merger
summary: SIBU, Nov 24 (Bernama) -- The merger of Parti Sarawak Bersatu (PSB) into the Progressive Democratic Party (PDP) came with no additional terms or conditions, PDP president Datuk Seri Tiong King Sing said in response to Datuk Seri Wong Soon Koh’s resignation from the party.

title: US Democrats Demand Investigation Into Nvidia CEO's Reinstatement, Raise National Security Concerns
summary: WASHINGTON, Nov 24 (Bernama-Anadolu) -- US Democratic congressional leaders on Monday called for investigations into Jensen Huang's reinstatement to the helm of Nvidia, accusing President Donald Trump and his administration of putting private financial interests ahead of US national security, Anadolu Ajansi reported.

title: UN Agency For Palestinians Says One Staffer Killed, 3 Injured In Israeli Attack On Gaza
summary: ISTANBUL, Nov 24 (Bernama-Anadolu) -- One staff member of the United Nations agency for Palestinian refugees (UNRWA) was killed and three others were injured in an Israeli attack in the Gaza Strip, the agency said Monday, Anadolu Ajansi reported.

title: Domestic Violence Often Begins With Controlling Behaviour â Expert
summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 24 (Bernama) -- Domestic violence often begins unnoticed through controlling behaviour and prolonged emotional abuse that gradually strips victims of their autonomy, rather than physical violence that leaves visible bruises or injuries.

title: Myanmar Junta Invitation, 3R Issues In Focus At Dewan Rakyat Today
summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 24 (Bernama) -- Malaysia’s recent invitation to the head of Myanmar’s junta and efforts to address race, religion and royalty (3R) issues are key matters to be raised at the Dewan Rakyat sitting today.

title: Sarawak's Economy, Tourism Set To Benefit From 2027 SEA Games - Abdul Karim
summary: KUCHING, Nov 24 (Bernama) -- The hosting of the 2027 SEA Games in Sarawak is expected to generate significant economic and tourism spin-offs for local industry players, particularly small-scale entrepreneurs, handicraft producers and the hospitality sector.
